verdict.rationale: Unreal documents several first-party scriptable surfaces that together cover the story. Python editor scripting can automate the placement, layout and settings of Actors in levels, drive asset pipelines and control the editor; it comes with a generated Python API reference and IDE stubs. The Remote Control API exposes the running engine over HTTP and WebSocket and can call any Blueprint-callable function. UnrealEditor -run=cook and the Unreal Automation Tool trigger cook, package and deploy builds from the command line. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent driving the editor end to end; the Python API reference is marked Experimental; no first-party agent bridge (no official Epic MCP, and community MCPs are unmaintained).
